intent: Increased sensor count from 5 to 7 to improve line coverage and detection robustness, maintaining sensor size at 0.016 for noise robustness. Shifted sensor y-positions forward by an additional +0.005 (to 0.065, 0.045, 0.025, 0.045, 0.065 for the original 5 sensors) to further improve early line detection and control anticipation. Adjusted sensor x-positions slightly within allowed range to [-0.07, 0.07] to optimize lateral line sensing and reduce steering oscillations. Retained wheel track at 0.16 and wheel radius at 0.035 to preserve turning stability and speed. These changes aim to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving progress and completion on both oval and s-bend tracks, supporting better generalization.
rationale: Integrator feedback and telemetry show persistent line loss events once per run and steering oscillations despite previous forward shifts of sensor y-positions and increased sensor size and wheel track. The current 5-sensor layout with y-positions shifted forward by +0.015 total (0.06, 0.04, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06) still results in line loss. Increasing sensor count to 7 improves line coverage and detection robustness, helping prevent line loss. Further forward shifting y-positions by +0.005 enhances early line detection and control anticipation. Slightly adjusting sensor x-positions within [-0.08, 0.08] aims to optimize lateral sensing and reduce steering oscillations. Retaining sensor size and wheel track preserves noise robustness and turning stability. This combined geometry refinement is expected to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving overall line following performance and completion rates.
